text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that's a wrap!
Both of you had wonderful smiles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "A brief rest after finishing the Oaks. While out and about, I saw a pair taking a commemorative photo who appeared to be an Umamusume and her Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the two of you side by side...
It makes for quite a lovely picture, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your hard work on the photoshoot!
This will definitely make the perfect commemorative photo
for the 'Best Partner Award.'

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
The "Best Partner Award"...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Best Partner Award"— An annual feature run by Monthly Twinkle to celebrate Umamusume and Trainer duos.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not only for success in races, but this was an honorable project
for racing professionals, where the two who had built
the strongest bond of trust would be chosen.
choice_data_list: Those two are incredible...!
Those two are amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly.
...It is a wonderful sight, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming hardships together...
To think that bond would be recognized like this.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Both of you look so happy.
...Fufu."
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, that's true.
...Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That Trainer must have devoted themselves to their Umamusume more than anyone else.
That's precisely why they became the greatest partners.
choice_data_list: （……Alright!）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days passed, and while I was going about my Trainer duties...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...!? Your skin is breaking out so badly... And look at the dark circles under your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking you seemed tired lately, but...
could it be lack of sleep?"
choice_data_list: ...Don't worry! This is nothing to me.
...Don't worry! Something like this is no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. Asking me not to worry...
How could I not be worried?
choice_data_list: I'm really okay. I've just been studying a lot lately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anatomy, physiology, nutrition...
I studied fields necessary for a Trainer like those
for as long as time permitted.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Working hard on your studies is wonderful, but...
pushing yourself too hard isn't good, you know?
choice_data_list: ...I want to win the Best Partner Award.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Watching Cesario look at the two of them that day,
she seemed so envious to me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A trainer and their Uma Musume bound by a tight bond—
that surely must be Cesario's ideal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then... for her sake,
I want to become the ideal Trainer.
choice_data_list: So I'm fully prepared to push myself a little!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer...
To think you care about me that much...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
“...... I understand.
In that case—will you grant my request?”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to shake off this fatigue from training.
Would you come out with me tomorrow?
choice_data_list: Of course! I'll go anywhere with you.
Of course! I'll tag along anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the place Cesario invited me to was...
my favorite cafe, the one I had told her
about before.
choice_data_list: Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to come here with you.
You mentioned you come here from time to time to unwind, after all.
choice_data_list: Still, today is supposed to be your day off...
Still, today is supposed to be your day off...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please don't worry about it.
This is a necessary rest for me as well.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Please allow me to escort you today.
I promise to make it a wonderful day off.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Mm... What a lovely aroma. How does
that chamomile tea taste to you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The moment you taste it, a comforting, refreshing flavor spreads across your palate.
A soothing sensation... as if being gently rocked in a cradle.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Chamomile tea has a calming effect that eases tension.
...I'm glad to hear it helped.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Also, could you hold out your hands?
Here, please have some hand cream.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I love the scent of lavender too.
It makes my heart feel so light and calm."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I would be happy if you felt the same way as I do.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's really calming...
Yeah, this is so relaxing...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Well, that's the most important thing.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was a wonderful café.
It was a truly soothing moment—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I hope Trainer feels the same way.
...They seemed to be pushing themselves without a break lately.
choice_data_list: ...I guess I ended up making you worry after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Of course.
After all, I am your partner.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Walking this path together with you and being chosen for the Best Partner Award... Nothing could be a greater honor.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: However, if you push yourself too hard in pursuit of your ideal and collapse, then—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I have no need for such an award.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Do you understand? Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The path to the future that I walk upon.
I want you to be right there beside me.
choice_data_list: (…I forgot something important.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Together, we will become the "foundation for future Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I leave her behind and struggle all on my own...
how could that dream ever be fulfilled?
choice_data_list: ...I really need to thank you.
...I really must thank you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...No, I should be the one thanking you.
You're the one who accepted my invitation, after all.
choice_data_list: Then next time, I'll be the one to invite you.
Then next time, I'll be the one to invite you.
Now I can keep doing my best with you starting tomorrow.
Now I can keep giving it my all with you starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...No, I should be the one thanking you.
You're the one who accepted my invitation, after all.
choice_data_list: Then next time, I'll be the one to invite you.
Then next time, I'll be the one to invite you.
Now I can keep doing my best with you starting tomorrow.
Now I can keep giving it my all with you starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes.
I would gladly go anywhere with you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can walk by your side,
that is where I belong.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Together with me... Fufu.
Yes, that's exactly right.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Please don't leave me all alone.
...Promise me, okay?
